newsitem.title: USA: Fleetwood buys shares from chairman.
newsitem.headline: Fleetwood buys shares from chairman.

text.p: Fleetwood Enterprises Inc said it bought 2,400,000 shares of its common stock from John Crean, its chairman and founder.
The shares were purchased at a price of $27-7/8 per share.
Prior to this announcement, the company had about 37.9 million shares of common stock. With the sale by Crean, the outstanding shares will be reduced to about 35.5 million.
The shares sold represent about 30 percent of Crean's holdings, which reduces his ownership position to about 15.8 percent of the outstanding shares.
